description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. The dataset contains three-dimensional antenna radiation-pattern measurements made in an anechoic chamber for AERPAW experiments. It covers RM-WB1-DN-BLK antennas in different orientations and SA-1400-5900 antennas, at listed frequencies from 902 MHz to 5500 MHz. The measured patterns describe directional antenna response for fixed and portable wireless nodes. The provider identifies propagation modelling and antenna-design optimisation as applications. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. Access links are supplied on the provider landing page. Licence, cost and access requirements remain uncertain for the linked release. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Wireless propagation modelling and antenna design. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
